completion_criteria.text: A DETAILED, APPROVED spec exists that makes ALL mitosis git actions performable without fail
The spec eliminates every fabricated-consent / classifier-bypass path (no self-asserted authorization)
The spec makes mitosis NEVER run `gh pr merge` (merge structurally removed, not gated); all PRs stay open; dependents stack on the parent's open-PR HEAD; humans merge outside mitosis
The spec grounds every load-bearing rule in deterministic Claude Code harness/git/server enforcement (never prose), each proven by a red->green demonstration
The spec preserves idempotent resume + reconcile without stable-name ref overwrites (content-addressed create-only refs + compare-and-swap), with concrete re-keying
The spec is grounded by the approved report + deep-audit artifact and survives adversarial review
